description: Canonical OCCT toolkit link set for the kernel host. Single source of truth consumed by BOTH native/kernel-host/CMakeLists.txt (target_link_libraries) and tools/build-native/native_tooling.py (occt_install_is_current cache validation), so the cache check can never validate fewer toolkits than the host actually links. Deliberately kept OUT of occt.manifest.json: editing this link list must not change the OCCT source-build fingerprint and trigger a full multi-hour OCCT rebuild.
